JmapVacationResponse.description:
A JMAP VacationResponse object (RFC 8621 §8.1).

There is exactly one VacationResponse object per account. Its `id`
is always `"singleton"`.

fromDate.description: Date/time (RFC 3339) from which the vacation response is active.

htmlBody.description: HTML body of the auto-reply message.

isEnabled.description: Whether the vacation response is currently enabled.

textBody.description: Plaintext body of the auto-reply message.

toDate.description: Date/time (RFC 3339) until which the vacation response is active.

description: Renderable table of the vacation response settings.
title: VacationTable
